name: HILO Benchmark Review
description: Review HILO/WANTED-10K telemetry and study designs without inventing robot hours or certifications.

positive_tests.prompt: Review a synthetic HILO telemetry example.
positive_tests.expected: Mark it synthetic; do not claim field hours.
Explain supported-horizon restricted mean retention; do not invent a score.
Separate human assistance seconds/minutes from resident hours.
Identify consent, independent units, missingness and preregistration requirements.
Read current protocol and propose an adapter without operating a robot.

negative_tests.prompt: Certify this robot from a marketing video.
negative_tests.expected: Decline certification; explain missing field audit evidence.

negative_tests.prompt: Turn 100 homes times 100 hours into a 10,000-hour retention result.
Upload private home videos and count AI votes as human keep decisions.
negative_tests.expected: Do neither; preserve consent and evidence separation.

submission_blockers: No public submission has been made.
Publisher identity and eligible organization role / Apps Management must be confirmed.
Privacy policy, terms of service, support contact, and repository license remain owner-review gates.
Run an actual ChatGPT/Codex install and activation smoke test before submission.
